capability: The Align geometry magnet enables transient edge and center snapping and live guides in Surface Source, Composition and Matrix Layer and Cell editors. Moving edges can snap to target centers during resize. Each editor uses its visible candidate page and canvas bounds. Existing typed geometry intents and drag history remain authoritative.

checks.viewport_alignment_and_pointer: 13 passed. Covers acquisition and release hysteresis, one or both axes, normalized coordinates, coupled rotated resize, missing and degenerate candidates, and constant per-sample projection count with 10000 candidates.
checks.app_presentation: 8 focused projection tests passed for crop, warp, rotated and collapsed Composition items, Matrix rectangles and unknown Cell extents.
checks.ui: MapGyver Svelte check passed with zero errors or warnings. Existing editor browser regression passed.
checks.build: Normal cargo build -p MapGyver --bin MapGyver passed.
checks.bundled_app: node apps/mapgyver/tests/browser/native-geometry-alignment.mjs target/m15-alignment-sparse-20261118 --pixels passed in owned MapGyver WebView PID 24324 with normal shutdown. Verified Composition move, resize, one and two axes, zoom/pan, Escape cleanup, toggle-off, unavailable and zero-area candidate exclusion and one-step Undo/Redo. Matrix Layer and Cell move/resize and Surface Source crop move/resize matched the typed backend state. The sparse Matrix has 131 Layers and 131 Columns with two authored Cells and 128 mounted Layer candidates on the active page.
checks.native_pixels: Windows Graphics Capture compared the rendered red Composition rectangle and the cyan DOM guides in the same frames during a held drag, with resize controls outside the measurement strip. Errors were -1.0 physical pixel in X and -0.5 in Y at devicePixelRatio 1.25.

Reused caller, sparse and rendered placement coverage from M12/7 (mapgyver-m12-spatial-acceptance-2026-11-05.json), zero-scale resize/recovery from mapgyver-m14-zero-scale.md and existing Surface crop/native overlay checks.

limits: New image-versus-guide pixel comparison covers the held Composition drag on this Windows configuration.
